summary: This is an 8-K containing preliminary Phase I/IIa clinical trial data for AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy. uniQure reported on the low-dose cohort's seizure reduction results and safety. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction is announced. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical data under Items 7.01 and 8.01.
